title: Seventeen more annual AI decisions and fifteen dated clarifications
summary: Twelve case readings and all five appendices now carry their prepared AI editorial decisions. Fifteen paragraphs clarify evidence scope, institutional attribution and the current AI review policy. Earlier wording and source dates remain available; 21 of 58 annual decisions are integrated.
evidence_note: Applies 17 previously prepared decisions on 61 complete sections and paragraphs. Ten readings have no earlier clarification object; their actual absence is preserved. Dated evidence receipts, battery-method follow-ups and local policy/workflow/translation inputs retain exact identities and versions. Three explicitly additional receipt links are not falsely presented as checks of every original source. No new primary retrieval, operating observation or measured series is added.
publication_effect: Local editorial integration only. No human study, legal-status certification, browser observation, safety classification, hosting or release is claimed. Thirty-seven annual assessments and wider build work remain.
